notes.title: More Bug Fixes - Version 1.0.1.1
notes.content:
Here's a small update for you all!  Some nasty bugs have been squashed.  Hope everyone is having a fantastic week!

- Fixed XP bug that caused rewards (exp and items) for all completed quests to repeat on load.
- Removed stats that had no purpose from the stats menu.
- Added more stat tracking to profile stats
- Fixed infinite wall jumping in Konstanz Mine and other areas

notes.title: Version 1.01 Live - Many Fixes And Changes!
notes.content:
Hello everyone.  We have a decent little update for you all!  I hope everyone is having a fantastic week so far.  Here are the many fixes and changes made to version 1.01.


- You can no longer respawn at dynamic dark portals (this is to prevent players getting stuck in a death loop).
- Decreased the vertical range of ground fire, and the Ground Slam or Earth Shield ability
- Kirkwall Barricade quest fixed.
- Removed heavenly weapon spawner from Ernwick guard tower.
- Fixed blunt and 2H axe weapon sounds.
- Fixed how Noble Double Rifle is held in the hands.
- You can no longer be attacked during cinematics or loading a safezone.
- Fixed falling through the floor after cinematics end or loading a safezone.
- The final boss can no longer be instakilled with one-handed weapons (woops, minor oversight).
- Daear flow no longer remains if the end cinematic is skipped.
- Books, notes, and NPC dialogue improved.
- Fixed the attic door in the gambler's quest.
- Added scrolling functionality to the journal to ensure all objectives are readable.
- Added descriptions and rewards to all quests.
- Fixed the issue where profiles read "End of Alpha" from the "Heart Tower" quest and onwards.
- Various consumable balance changes.
- Changed the demon grunt at the top of the rib tower to a Demon Overlord (to match the dialogue of the Grimsby priest).
- Lowered the levels of the new Demon Overlord at the top of the rib tower and the one in the foot tower.
- Reduced the size of the Blaylock safezone so that it cannot be activated from outside the cathedral.
- Midridge under the bridge safezone boundaries fixed to keep the possessed off the player while they're in the safezone.

notes.title: Development Update for The Black Masses.
notes.content:
Hello everyone.  The Black Masses has been a long ride for the team here at Brilliant Game Studios, we have a huge love for the world we created, and the community behind it.  The timeline was longer than anticipated, and we’ve heard your feedback for an increase in updates for the game. We had also wished to have provide more frequent updates.  We are currently working diligently on Ultimate Epic Battle Simulator 2.  Below I will go over some of the reasons TBM has not seen an update for a while, and why we have shifted development to UEBS2.

  The Black Masses has been a huge undertaking and an epic journey for us.  Our team only consists of 4 full time members in a studio with funding from our own pockets.  The Black Masses began as a dream, and will continue as a labor of love as it has gone considerably over budget; and regrettably we can no longer financially afford to continue to develop this game at the same pace.  However, even though we have not seen profits, we are still going to finish the game.  The main reason we shifted to UEBS2 is so that our studio can continue operating, and we can continue to bring updates to you.  

  For those who have been with us from the beginning, you may know that Ultimate Epic Battle Simulator is the reason we were given the freedom to create this ambitious title.  And though we do not expect to ever see profits come from this title, we still want to see this to the end. Our studio looks forward to continuing this incredible journey with you, and completing this game. Thank you for your continued support and feedback.

notes.title: Hotfix For V0.98
notes.content:
We fixed a few issues that came with this update.

-New safezone bugs that caused players to fall through floors fixed.
-Crossbow and musket fire sounds fixed.
-Multiplayer sounds fixed where other players crossbows sounded like a musket rifle.
-Buffed new secret high level weapon.

Hope everyone is doing well!

notes.title: Update 0.98 Now Live!
notes.content:
The wait is over!  Explore almost the entire half of the Island, along side new abilities, story quests and side quests!    We shall list the new features below!


-Almost the entire lower half of the island is now explorable(Except the large city connecting the 2 sides).
-Level cap raised to level 60, with a large array of new blessings/abilities!
- Improved walking and stepping physics to prevent getting stuck on walkways and falling through stairwells (also fixed a crash condition here)
-Added molotov cocktails.
-Thrown item damage now scales with survival attribute.
-Profile saving now attempts to stop corrupt saves/crashes by creating a backup.
-Significant optimization focused on GPU performance. (Improved performance on lower end cards as well as high resolution screen resolution on higher end GPUs).
-AI improvements in behavior and performance.  (Most notable is they always see you now)
-New high level weapons added.
-New battle added which contains tens of thousands of characters.  The battle can be played multiple times.


I hope everyone has a fantastic weekend!

Regards,

Brilliant Game Studios

notes.title: Large Content Update Coming Very Soon!
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34136744/dbb0db568f5b038d4ade42dea5213c471403eab9.png[/img]

notes.title: Hotfix for V0.96
notes.content:
Hey everyone!  Just a few critical issues addressed in a small hotfix.


-Bug fixed where some areas wouldn't load.
-Giant prop set in Perth fixed.

Hope everyone is having a fantastic week!

Regards.

notes.title: Performance Update V0.96 Now Live! (Please report any issues)
notes.content:
We are pleased to announce the big performance update is now live!  Our tests confirm upwards of 20%-50% performance improvements.  However, some of the changes we made are experimental, and we wish this to be a trail run to ensure stability.  Please report any issues you experience, particularly in crashes.  If you are experiencing crashes, and you weren't before, please report this to us.

  Patch notes:

-  Performance increases 20-40% across the game using threaded rendering.(Very noticeable in large cities)
- Performance increase of 10-20% in crowd rendering as well as distant landscape rendering, increase is due to improved DX11 instancing.
- Remaining Issues in Kirkwall quests with saving and events fixed.
- Sound/muzzle flash bug on crossbow in multiplayer now fixed.
- Main menu improvements.
- Bug fixed when modifying graphics for the first time often put screen at low resolution.
- Issue fixed where sound volume settings often did not apply when first loading game.
- Issue fixed where items meant to appear/trigger during quests sometimes wouldn't.
- Demo version fully updated to latest version.

  We hope you all enjoy the FPS increase!  Have a fantastic week!

Regards,

Robert.

notes.title: Performance Update Coming Next Week(Experimental)
notes.content:
We are pleased to announce that we are working on some significant performance increases in The Black Masses.  We have seen upwards of 20-50% performance increases with some recent experimenting we have done.

  However, we only have so many machines to test on, so we want to release this update as a trial run to ensure stability on different machines.  As a warning, if things do not goo smoothly we may have to revert the update if we deem the update too unstable.

I hope everyone is having a fantastic week!

Regards,

Robert.

notes.title: Hotfix For July 6th
notes.content:
We have done a few small patches over the past week.  Some changes/fixes are listed below.


July 6th:
-Kirkwall quests fixed which was corrupting profiles.
- Fixed an issue with the Daear capacity blessings under the Dark Arts tree where the effects of the second blessing would overwrite the effects of the first blessing.
- Added a temporary fallback system which should detect errors during profile loading and prevent the corruption of your profile.
- Fixed an issue with The Gambler's Sword.  If you have already finished this quest but you don't have the sword, you can get it from the house where you finished the quest.



June 29th:
-Ammo save bug has been fixed.
-Special weapons save bug fixed.
-If you lost ammo or weapons from the save bug, our system attempts to restore. (Ammo is given based on your level, and quest special weapons are rewarded based on quest completion).
-Multiplayer bug with incorrect player names fixed, which caused issues with private games.

  We are working hard to increase stability.  Have a fantastic week everyone!

Regards,

Robert.

notes.title: Large Content Update v0.95 Now Live!
notes.content:
It's finally here everyone!  The first large content update for The Black Masses is now live.  

Trailer:
[previewyoutube=pSiQCgVdDBk;leftthumb][/previewyoutube]

NOTE: For those of you who have beaten the game   We have done our best to make sure old profiles can continue playing in this version.   Blessing points will be reset on old profiles, so you simply need to reassign them!  Old players who beat the game should also check their journal for a new story quest.

  Below we will list some of the new content and changes. 


Content:
-New map areas added.  (Several towns and cities, the Redwood forest and more).
-Level cap increased to 40.
-A multitude of new side quests and secret areas.
-Main questline continues to Perth City.
-Large amount of shiny new weapons and items.
-Several new abilities and skills added.
-New cinematic added.


Patchnotes:
-Improved opening cinematic visuals.
- Level up now restores your vitals
-Dead zombie planking issues improved.
-Glitch in idle animation for one handed weapons fixed.
- Changes and improvements made to input mapping.
- Inventory scrollbar functionality added.
- Improved ability to reach over surfaces that extend behind the player's head when climbing upwards or jumping upwards to climb.
- Increased radius of item looting check.
- Descriptions for stats now show in a tooltip in the stats tab when you hover over the names.
- Reduced camera shake on throwing.
- Added the option to make weapon scrolling the primary use of the mouse wheel (the mouse wheel scrolls through abilities by default and holding 'E' and scrolling scrolls through weapons).
- Added the option to disable item and consumable scrolling which will make the controls for throwing items and cooking grenades more straightforward.
- Added more sounds (using consumables, jumping, landing, running, climbing).
- Opening the main menu in offline play now pauses the game (inventory, blessings, map, etc. does not pause).
- Decreased max catch speed (if you would take extreme fall damage, you can't catch a ledge at that speed).
- Health regen.
- Regen delay changed from 5 seconds to 10 seconds.
- Regen amount reduced to 0.5% per second.
- Added stamina cost to climbing-related actions.
- Blessing tree changes (new blessings added and existing ones reworked)
- New abilities added (Spread Shot, Shockwave, Blast Hammer)
- Added default damage modifiers to sharp weapons and ranged weapons, reducing their effectiveness against armor, while blunt weapons maintain normal damage against armor.


Hundreds of other small changes and fixes were made.

Have a fantastic summer everyone!!

Regards,

Robert.

notes.title: Large Content Update On The Way!
notes.content:
We apologize for the delay, but a content update is finally on the way.  We are now back at the office after a long quarantine, but we were all at home working hard on a content update!  We hope to get one out sometime in the next few weeks here.  While we were in quarantine, large content updates were near impossible since our project is now in the hundreds of gigs.  


Edit (June 19th):  We apologize for the delay.  Since this is such a large update we are working on, quality assurance and touch ups are taking longer than expected.   Expect to see the update sometime next week.


Hope everyone is having a fantastic week!

Regards,

Robert.

notes.title: Update v 0.9.3
notes.content:
Welcome to update v0.9.3!  We finally brought steam friends into multiplayer!  Here are some changes made.

-Steam friends are now integrated in online coop game sorting.
-You can now host private games for friends only
-Eiras side quest fixed.
-Many changes made to quests stopping players from skipping, or having no active main quests.
-Other small bugs and changes were made.


Hope everyone is having a great weekend.  Now grab a friend and play some Black Masses!

Regards,

Robert.

notes.title: Hotfix v 0.9.2
notes.content:
Hello everyone.  We are working hard to get this game as stable as possible!  Here are some of the changes fixes in update v0.9.2.  Most of the fixes in this update focus on quests and stability.


-Some crucial bugs were fixed involving quest saving and multiplayer quest syncing.  Which often caused progress to be lost.
-Tower safe zone bug fixed where player would sometimes fall through the floor when spawning.
-The Rescue quest fixed where player could move onto the next quest without without talking to survivors and completing.
-Battle of the hand tower quest changes.  Marker appears on bell letting player know he must ring the bell before the battle will start.  Other fixes were made to this quest.
-More bugs fixed in loot spawning.(Main focus was for weapons spawning that could not be picked up)
-New loot and weapons added.
-More accidental units removed off beach area.

  Happy Monday everyone!

Regards,
Robert.

notes.title: Blackness Bug Fix, And More! v0.5.2
notes.content:
Hey everyone.  We have a bug focused update here.

-Blackness bug now detected on incompatible hardware.  As a result global illumination is disabled when detected.(Unfortunately light looks poor and interiors are bright).
-Strange bug fixed where low LOD zombies would be frozen in one spot.
- Added in-game item tooltips
- Fixed issues with dropping items causing errors
- Player height no longer decreases after crouching
- Added semi-auto gun mechanics
- Double barrel musket now fires separate shots
- Musket "ammo" is now spelled correctly, and groups properly in inventory
- Decreased the increase in attack range when attacking downwards
- Players can no longer hit zombies through walls... mostly (some walls use mesh colliders)
- Dragging items around in inventory no longer copies its name to multiple slots.

Thank you everyone for continuing to support the game.  Don't forget to tell get your friends online!

Regards,

Robert.

notes.title: Multiplayer Now Live In Free Demo!
notes.content:
Multiplayer has arrived and we are very excited to play with all of you!  You can play with up to 4 players per game.  campaign is fully playable in multiplayer(First quest and tutorials are disabled in online mode).



Changes/Fixes:
-Coop multiplayer added to demo
- Input customization is now saved
- Controller remapping is now possible (this should fix the issues with PS4 controllers)
-fixed duplicates of available resolutions in graphics settings
- Vaulting test now requires forwards movement input
- Fixed issue where player would stand up through obstacles after climbing over a surface
- Climb over and vault now account for character height correctly (fixes vaulting into complex geometry and getting stuck in the vault state)
- When in the water, swimming is mandatory.  Running around on the seabed is no longer allowed
- Climbing after using an ability or throwing a grenade no longer breaks the character
- When exiting water, player can no longer move at walking speed while crouching
- Increased character height when crouched
-Graphic setting changes
-Font changes in menu

Hotfix!
(Nov 21st evening)
-Quick join was broken but is now fixed!
-Paddle added to starting beach in multiplayer.
(Nov 22nd Morning)
-Memory leak removed which caused freeze lags.
-Resolution list in graphics settings fixed.
(Nov 22nd Evening)
-Strange animation bug fixed, where player appeared to hover on floors and other surfaces.
-Other internal changes made.
(Nov 24th morning)
Time of day now active in multiplayer.

Known issues:
-Crossbow makes a musket gun and  sound when fired for other players.
-Restoring default inputs doesn't necessarily do what it says it does.

Other notes:
in a near update, we plan to add 'Duel' mode so players can challenge eachother to a duel and fight to the death.

notes.title: Update - Alpha Demo 0.2
notes.content:
We apologize for the wait on this update everyone, but now Alpha 0.2 is here!


HOT FIX!   Army of 50,000 zombies was left in the world and removed today!
Read the funny story about that here: https://steamcommunity.com/app/992910/discussions/0/1693843461199437825/

Graphics and Optimization:

- Freeze lags reduced.  The problem came from a memory leak, which cause freeze lags and sometimes crashes in mid to low spec computers.
-Many new optimizations have been implemented, adding an average of 10-15 FPS boost on average.  
-Graphics settings now have increased scaling, meaning you will see larger frame rate differences across graphics settings.
-Graphics memory reduced.
-Lighting has been improved.  Trees now cast long range ambient occlusion, as well as better color correction in ambient lighting.
-Distant landscape lighting improved.  Trees cast shadows and AO at infinite draw distance.
-Rain added to weather.


Player Changes/Fixes:

-Camera sensitivity customization added to options.
-Damage shown for weapons now shows actual 'leveled damage'.
-Fixed death from fall damage
-Fixed screen redness from fall damage
-Player can no longer use a weapon while swimming
-Swimming drag adjusted for jumping into water
-Gravity decreased
-Climbing wall lunge (hold space then press 'W') distance modified
-Player ragdoll physics modified so the player can get back up sooner
-Grenade rolling and bounce physics modified
-Fire effect no longer gets stuck active
-other miscellaneous fixes

notes.title: Patch Notes Alpha Demo 0.1.1
notes.content:
First update for the alpha demo is now live!

Changes:

-Fire Rune quest removed and replaced with finding a key for the mine entrances.  Many other changes were made to quests which we will not spoil. ;)

-The ability to turn on your light has been added right at the start of the game.  (Press L once you pick up lamp at start tutorial)

-Sound options added.

-Player has 'rag doll' like death animation on death, (No more strange red screen while standing around).


Fixes:

-Bug fixed where player could fly after swimming.

- Plastic like shininess on sand removed when wet.

-Other small internal fixes/changes.


Edit: Saturday night Hotfix:

-Key quest fix where dialog with priest never actually completes quest.

-Bug fixed for Clear Storage House quest.  Map markers were shown far out of place.

-Bug fix where player falls through floor if spawned in cave safezone.

-Trees are now rendered in reflections on 'Ultra'.  (for high end PCs)

-Some optimizations made.


We greatly appreciate everyone's feedback on this ambitious project of ours!  We are very excited to build with world with you all!

Regards,

Robert.

notes.title: Development Update
notes.content:
Hello everyone!  First I would like to apologize for our silence the past few months.  We are working very hard to get the demo into your hands.  The reason we haven't been doing many updates is because we want to use our time on development to get this demo in good shape.


  We are still hoping to get the demo out before the end of the summer and we are making excellent progress.  Though we are trying our hardest, we still cannot say for certain when the exact release date will be until we are a week or 2 away.

  The Black Masses is looking better than ever and we cannot wait to share our hard work with all of you.

Regards,

Robert.
